name: Yang2003
header:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<VTKFile type="ImageData" version="0.1" byte_order="LittleEndian" compressor="vtkZLibDataCompressor">
  <RD format_version="2">
  
    <description>
        L. Yang and I.R. Epstein. (2003) "Oscillatory Turing Patterns in Reaction-Diffusion Systems with Two Coupled Layers"<br>
        <a href="http://hopf.chem.brandeis.edu/pubs/pub288%20rep.pdf">http://hopf.chem.brandeis.edu/pubs/pub288%20rep.pdf</a>
        
        Figure 3(a) from the paper. Isolated spirals develop.
        
        In the paper the chemicals are named x,z,r,u,w. Here we use a,b,c,d,e. 
        Two Oregonator systems a,b and d,e are coupled with a middle layer c.
    </description>
    
    <rule name="Yang2003" type="formula" wrap="1">
      <param name="timestep">       0.001       </param>
      <param name="Da">             0.1          </param>
      <param name="Db">             0.1          </param>
      <param name="Dc">             0.1          </param>
      <param name="Dd">             5.0          </param>
      <param name="De">             100.0        </param>
      <param name="epsilon">        0.14         </param>
      <param name="param_f">        1.6          </param>
      <param name="epsilon_bar">    0.4          </param>
      <param name="param_f_bar">    1.1          </param>
      <param name="q">              0.01         </param>
      <param name="q_bar">          0.01         </param>
      <formula number_of_chemicals="5">
        delta_a = Da * laplacian_a + ( a - a*a - param_f*b*(a-q)/(a+q) ) / epsilon - (a-c)/(2.0f*epsilon);
        delta_b = Db * laplacian_b + a - b;
        delta_c = Dc * laplacian_c + (a-c)/(2.0f*epsilon) + (d-c)/(2.0f*epsilon_bar);
        delta_d = Dd * laplacian_d + ( d - d*d - param_f_bar*e*(d-q_bar)/(d+q_bar) ) / epsilon_bar - (d-c)/(2.0f*epsilon_bar);
        delta_e = De * laplacian_e + d - e;
      </formula>
    </rule>
    
    <initial_pattern_generator apply_when_loading="true">
      <overlay chemical="a">
        <overwrite />
        <constant value="0.0449" />
        <everywhere />
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="b">
        <overwrite />
        <constant value="0.0449" />
        <everywhere />
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="c">
        <overwrite />
        <constant value="0.0505" />
        <everywhere />
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="c">
        <add />
        <white_noise low="-0.02" high="0.02" />
        <everywhere />
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="d">
        <overwrite />
        <constant value="0.0666" />
        <everywhere />
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="e">
        <overwrite />
        <constant value="0.0666" />
        <everywhere />
      </overlay>
    </initial_pattern_generator>
    
    <render_settings>
      <color_low r="0" g="0" b="0" />
      <color_high r="1" g="1" b="1" />
      <show_color_scale value="true" />
      <show_multiple_chemicals value="true" />
      <active_chemical value="a" />
      <low value="0.02" />
      <high value="0.2" />
      <show_displacement_mapped_surface value="false" />
      <timesteps_per_render value="100" />
    </render_settings>
    
  </RD>
  <ImageData WholeExtent="0 127 0 127 0 0"></ImageData>
</VTKFile>
